senses.en: to introduce yourself and get to know the people living near you

ex.en: We moved into a new flat and went to meet the neighbours.
ex.zh: 我们搬进了新公寓，并去结识了邻居们。

ex.en: During the community picnic, children played games together and helped their parents meet the neighbours.
ex.zh: 在社区野餐活动中，孩子们一起做游戏，还帮父母结识了邻居。

col: meet the neighbours warmly｜热情地结识邻居
go to meet the neighbours｜去拜访结识邻居
meet the new neighbours｜结识新邻居
tip: neighbour 是英式拼写，美式作 neighbor，常加 s 指多位邻居。

senses.en: to meet people you like and begin friendly relationships with them

ex.en: Joining a football club is a great way to make new friends.
ex.zh: 加入足球社团是交新朋友的好方法。

ex.en: At the summer science camp, students from different schools worked in teams to make new friends.
ex.zh: 在夏季科学营里，来自不同学校的学生分组合作，结交了新朋友。

col: make new friends easily｜容易交到新朋友
love to make new friends｜喜欢交新朋友
make new friends at school｜在学校交新朋友
tip: 注意 friend 后面要加 s 用复数，不能说 make new friend。

senses.en: to move across smooth ice wearing special boots with metal blades

ex.en: Let's put on warm coats and go ice skating this Saturday afternoon.
ex.zh: 这个周六下午我们穿上暖和的外套去滑冰吧。

ex.en: In winter, many children in northern cities go ice skating on frozen lakes after school.
ex.zh: 冬天，北方城市的许多孩子放学后会在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

col: go ice skating in winter｜冬天去滑冰
learn to go ice skating｜学着去滑冰
go ice skating together｜一起去滑冰
tip: skate 去 e 加 ing 变成 skating，表示“去滑冰”前面用 go。

senses.en: to make soft balls of snow and toss them playfully in winter

ex.en: The excited children ran into the yard to throw snowballs and laugh.
ex.zh: 兴奋的孩子们跑到院子里扔雪球、欢笑。

ex.en: After the heavy snowfall, students wore thick gloves to throw snowballs safely in the playground.
ex.zh: 大雪过后，同学们戴上厚手套，在操场上安全地扔雪球玩。

col: throw snowballs at friends｜朝朋友扔雪球
play and throw snowballs｜玩耍扔雪球
throw snowballs happily｜开心地扔雪球
tip: snowball 由 snow 和 ball 合成，扔雪球通常用复数 snowballs。

senses.en: Before the present time, following an expression of time

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
ex.zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
ex.zh: 许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。

col: a long time ago｜很久以前
as recently as a year ago｜就在一年前
tip: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。

senses.en: a card mailed without an envelope, often showing a picture

ex.en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
ex.zh: 她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。

ex.en: Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
ex.zh: 虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。

tip: 寄给某人可说send someone a postcard或用to引出收件人。

senses.en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections.
Far from people or rarely visited.

ex.en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
ex.zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。

ex.en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。

tip: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

senses.en: to feel sad because someone or something you love is far away

ex.en: I really miss my grandparents when they go back to their hometown.
ex.zh: 爷爷奶奶回老家时，我真的很想念他们。

ex.en: When students travel far from home for camp, they often miss their parents and pets.
ex.zh: 当学生们离家远行参加夏令营时，他们常常会想念父母和宠物。

col: miss my family｜想念我的家人
miss you very much｜非常想念你
tip: 本课指“想念；思念”，第三人称单数加 es 变成 misses。

senses.en: an extra note added at the end of a letter or email after your name

ex.en: I forgot one thing, so I added a short PS at the bottom.
ex.zh: 我忘了一件事，所以在信尾加了一句简短的附言。

ex.en: Before sending the birthday invitation, Lily wrote a friendly PS reminding friends to bring swimsuits.
ex.zh: 在寄出生日邀请函前，莉莉写了一句友好的附言，提醒朋友们带泳衣。

col: write a short PS｜写一句简短附言
PS at the end｜信末的附言
tip: PS 是 postscript 的缩写，两个字母通常都要大写，用在信尾。

senses.en: Without a permanent place to live.

ex.en: The flood left several families homeless in our town.
ex.zh: 洪水使我们镇上的几户家庭无家可归。

ex.en: Affordable housing and accessible support services are essential to helping homeless people rebuild stable lives.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房和便利的援助服务，对帮助无家可归者重建稳定生活至关重要。

col: leave someone homeless｜使某人无家可归
a homeless shelter｜无家可归者收容所
tip: 不能说a homeless；应说a homeless person。

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

col: a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板
tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

senses.en: to collect money from people to help others or support a good cause

ex.en: We sold old storybooks at the school fair to raise money for charity.
ex.zh: 我们在学校义卖会上卖旧故事书，为慈善事业募捐钱。

ex.en: Students painted colourful postcards and organized a bake sale to raise money for stray animals.
ex.zh: 同学们画了彩色明信片并组织了烘焙义卖，为流浪动物募捐钱款。

col: raise money for charity｜为慈善募捐
tip: raise 在这里意为“筹集；募集”，注意 money 是不可数名词。

senses.en: used to show that you feel very happy and eager about something

ex.en: Tomorrow is our school sports day, and I'm so excited!
ex.zh: 明天就是学校运动会了，我太激动了！

ex.en: We are going to visit the science museum this Friday morning, and I'm so excited!
ex.zh: 这周五上午我们要去参观科学博物馆，我太激动了！

col: Have a great time!｜玩得开心！
tip: excited 用于形容人的感受“激动的”；形容事物有趣用 exciting。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese style of painting using black ink and water on paper

ex.en: My grandfather likes drawing bamboo in a beautiful Chinese ink painting.
ex.zh: 我爷爷喜欢在一幅美丽的中国水墨画里画竹子。

ex.en: In art class, our teacher showed us how to create a mountain ink painting gently.
ex.zh: 美术课上，老师向我们展示了如何轻柔地创作一幅山水墨画。

col: draw an ink painting｜画一幅水墨画
tip: ink 指“墨水；墨汁”，水墨画作可数名词时一幅画用 an ink painting。

senses.en: a colourful picture painted with thick paints made using special oil

ex.en: There is a bright oil painting of sunflowers hanging on our wall.
ex.zh: 我们墙上挂着一幅明亮的向日葵油画。

ex.en: During our art museum visit, we admired a famous oil painting with rich blue skies.
ex.zh: 参观美术馆时，我们欣赏了一幅有着浓郁蓝天的著名油画。

col: colourful oil painting｜色彩丰富的油画
paint an oil painting｜画一幅油画
tip: oil 以元音音素开头，表示“一幅油画”时前面要用 an。

senses.en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art
a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally

ex.en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
ex.zh: 这位画家用柔和的蓝色描绘了港口。

ex.en: Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.
ex.zh: 公共资助使艺术家能够创作丰富社区生活的作品，而不必完全依赖销售收入。

tip: artist指艺术家；artistic是形容词“艺术的”。

senses.en: a tool with soft hairs on the end used for putting paint on paper

ex.en: Please wash your paintbrush in clean water after finishing your picture.
ex.zh: 画完画后，请用清水洗干净你的画笔。

ex.en: Before starting our art project, every student picked a soft paintbrush and bright watercolours.
ex.zh: 开始美术制作前，每位同学都挑选了一支柔软的画笔和鲜艳的水彩。

tip: 由 paint 和 brush 合成，复数形式要加 es 变成 paintbrushes。

senses.en: Having great physical strength or producing a strong effect.
Able to control people or strongly influence events.

ex.en: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
ex.zh: 大风把我们的花园椅子吹到了草地上。

ex.en: Powerful companies should take greater responsibility for reducing the environmental damage caused by their operations.
ex.zh: 有影响力的企业应承担更大责任，减少其经营活动造成的环境破坏。

col: powerful engine｜动力强劲的发动机
tip: 通常作形容词；副词用powerfully，不用powerful。

senses.en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion.
Providing a faster service than usual.
Clearly and directly stated.

ex.en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
ex.zh: 莉娅用一个温暖的微笑表达了谢意。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会对影响其教育的决策发表意见。

tip: express作动词直接接宾语，如express your views。

senses.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.
Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.

ex.en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
ex.zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。

ex.en: Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.
ex.zh: 当地画家既能传承文化传统，也能让年轻观众接触新的艺术风格。

tip: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

senses.en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

col: my own room｜我自己的房间
of your own｜属于你自己的
tip: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

senses.en: any person, without restriction
a person, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。

ex.en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

senses.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.
One part of something divided among people or groups.
One of the equal units of ownership in a company.

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

senses.en: to make listeners or readers feel deeply moved, warm, or cared about

ex.en: Kind words and warm smiles can easily touch people's hearts every day.
ex.zh: 友善的话语和温暖的微笑每天都能轻松打动人心。

ex.en: The children's choir sang a gentle song about nature that could really touch people's hearts.
ex.zh: 儿童合唱团唱了一首关于自然的温柔歌曲，十分打动人心。

col: deeply touch people's hearts｜深深打动人心
music can touch people's hearts｜音乐能打动人心
stories that touch people's hearts｜打动人心的故事
tip: touch 在这里指情感上的“触动；感动”，hearts 用复数对应 people。

senses.en: to let others see how happy, sad, or excited you feel inside

ex.en: Young children often show their feelings through bright drawings and cheerful songs.
ex.zh: 小朋友们常常用明亮的图画和欢快的歌曲来表现自己的情感。

ex.en: In drama club, students practice using clear voices and facial expressions to show their feelings.
ex.zh: 在戏剧社团里，学生们练习用清晰的声音和面部表情来表达情感。

col: show one's true feelings｜表达真实情感
learn to show one's feelings｜学会表达情感
show one's feelings openly｜坦率表现情感
tip: 使用时把 one's 换成 my 或 their 等物主代词，表达“情感”常用复数。

senses.en: to be very well known by many people because of a special thing

ex.en: Shenzhen is famous for its modern parks and beautiful seaside views.
ex.zh: 深圳因它现代化的公园和美丽的海滨风光而出名。

ex.en: In geography class, we learned that Hangzhou is famous for West Lake and green tea.
ex.zh: 在地理课上，我们了解到杭州因西湖和绿茶而闻名。

col: be famous for delicious food｜因美食而出名
be famous for nature｜因自然风光闻名
be famous for its history｜因历史悠久而出名
tip: for 后接出名的原因或特色，使用时要根据主语把 be 变成 am/is/are。

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
ex.zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。

ex.en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
ex.zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: to do gentle exercises before sports so your body is ready to move

ex.en: Always warm up for five minutes before you start running or swimming.
ex.zh: 开始跑步或游泳前，一定要先热身五分钟。

ex.en: Our PE teacher leads the whole class to warm up together before every basketball game.
ex.zh: 每场篮球赛前，体育老师都会带领全班同学一起做热身运动。

col: warm up before exercise｜运动前热身
warm up your legs｜活动腿部热身
do a quick warm up｜快速热身
tip: 作动词短语表示“做热身运动”，运动前热身可以预防身体受伤。

senses.en: to have pain or an injury on your body from an accident

ex.en: Wear a helmet on your bike so you do not get hurt.
ex.zh: 骑自行车时戴好头盔，这样你就不会受伤。

ex.en: Our safety teacher reminded us never to run on wet floors because we might get hurt.
ex.zh: 安全老师提醒我们不要在湿滑的地板上跑，因为那样可能会受伤。

col: try not to get hurt｜尽量不受伤
get hurt while playing｜玩耍时受伤
tip: hurt 在这里是形容词“受伤的”，过去式仍是 get hurt（got hurt）。

senses.en: to shout loudly or phone emergency workers when someone is in danger

ex.en: If you see a fire, stay calm and call for help right away.
ex.zh: 如果你看到火灾，请保持冷静并立刻呼叫救援。

ex.en: During our safety drill, we practiced how to use a phone to call for help clearly.
ex.zh: 在安全演练中，我们练习了如何用电话清晰地呼叫救援。

col: call for help loudly｜大声呼救
call for help at once｜立刻呼叫救援
know when to call for help｜知道何时求助
tip: 既可指大声呼救，也可指打电话向警方、消防或急救人员求援。

senses.en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working.
A short period when an activity stops.
To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

senses.en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand.
A projecting part of an object, especially a chair.
To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.

ex.en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。

ex.en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。

col: arm someone with knowledge｜用知识充实某人
tip: 表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

senses.en: a special outdoor park with smooth ramps built for skateboarding and scooters

ex.en: Tom goes to the neighbourhood skatepark with his friends every sunny weekend.
ex.zh: 每个晴朗的周末，汤姆都会和朋友去社区滑板运动场。

ex.en: At the new city skatepark, young riders must wear helmets and knee pads for safety.
ex.zh: 在新的城市滑板运动场，年轻的滑手们为了安全必须戴头盔和护膝。

col: ride at a skatepark｜在滑板场玩滑板
safe skatepark rules｜滑板场安全规则
tip: 由 skate（滑冰/滑板）和 park（公园）合并组成的一个单词。

senses.en: By good fortune, often avoiding an unpleasant result.

ex.en: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
ex.zh: 我的包掉下来摔开了，幸好没有东西掉出来。

ex.en: The storm damaged several classrooms, but luckily the school had already moved its students to a safer building.
ex.zh: 暴风雨损坏了几间教室，但幸好学校已将学生转移到一栋更安全的建筑中。

col: luckily for us｜对我们来说幸好
luckily no one was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip: 常修饰整个句子，放句首时通常后接逗号。

senses.en: A strong protective covering worn on the head

ex.en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
ex.zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet can reduce the risk of serious head injuries among cyclists involved in accidents.
ex.zh: 骑车时佩戴头盔，可以降低事故中头部严重受伤的风险。

tip: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

senses.en: a soft, thick piece of material worn to protect knees or elbows

ex.en: Put on each knee pad carefully before you ride your skateboard outside.
ex.zh: 到户外玩滑板前，请仔细戴好每一个护膝防护垫。

ex.en: Every student in our roller-skating club wears a soft pad on each elbow and knee.
ex.zh: 我们轮滑社团的每位同学都在手肘和膝盖上戴着柔软的防护垫。

tip: 可数名词，常与 knee 或 elbow 搭配成护膝、护肘，多用复数 pads。

senses.en: to telephone emergency medical services to bring a special hospital vehicle

ex.en: When someone falls and cannot stand up, adults call an ambulance quickly.
ex.zh: 如果有人摔倒起不来，大人们会迅速叫救护车。

ex.en: In first-aid class, the nurse taught us when and how to call an ambulance properly.
ex.zh: 在急救课上，护士教了我们什么时候以及如何正确叫救护车。

col: call an ambulance immediately｜立即叫救护车
need to call an ambulance｜需要叫救护车
call an ambulance in China｜在中国拨打急救电话
tip: ambulance 以元音音素 /æ/ 开头，所以前面必须用不定冠词 an。

senses.en: to look carefully at cuts or bruises on someone's body to help them

ex.en: The kind school nurse helped check his injuries after he fell down.
ex.zh: 他摔倒后，和蔼的校医帮他检查了受伤情况。

ex.en: After the minor bike accident, the doctor came quickly to check her injuries with care.
ex.zh: 那场小自行车事故后，医生很快赶来仔细检查她的受伤情况。

col: carefully check one's injuries｜仔细检查伤情
check one's injuries first｜先检查受伤情况
help check one's injuries｜帮忙检查伤势
tip: injury 变复数时要把 y 改 i 再加 es；one's 需替换为具体代词。

senses.en: a trained person, like a firefighter or paramedic, who helps in sudden danger

ex.en: Every brave emergency worker helps keep people safe during storms and fires.
ex.zh: 每位勇敢的应急工作人员都在暴风雨和火灾中保护大家的安全。

ex.en: An emergency worker visited our school today to show us fire trucks and rescue tools.
ex.zh: 今天一位应急工作人员来到我们学校，给我们展示了消防车和救援工具。

col: brave emergency worker｜勇敢的应急工作人员
thank an emergency worker｜感谢应急人员
call an emergency worker｜呼叫应急工作人员
tip: emergency 以元音音素开头，表示“一名”时前面用 an；复数加 s。

senses.en: a special medical picture that lets doctors see the bones inside your body

ex.en: The doctor took an X-ray of Ben's arm to check his bone.
ex.zh: 医生给本的手臂拍了 X 光检查，看看骨头有没有事。

ex.en: In science class, we saw an X-ray image showing all the tiny bones in a hand.
ex.zh: 科学课上，我们看到了一张展示人手部所有小骨头的 X 光检查图像。

col: take an X-ray｜拍 X 光片
get an X-ray｜做 X 光检查
clear X-ray picture｜清晰的 X 光片
tip: X 发音为 /eks/，以元音音素开头，所以“一次 X 光检查”用 an X-ray。

senses.en: to decide which person or thing you want
to decide to do something rather than something else

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。

ex.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。

col: choose to do something｜选择做某事
tip: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

senses.en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.
Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
ex.zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。

ex.en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
ex.zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

tip: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

senses.en: to press something or move it away by applying force
to strongly encourage or force someone to act
an act of pushing or a determined effort

ex.en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
ex.zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？

ex.en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。

col: push someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
tip: push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
ex.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

ex.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
ex.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

col: pull a door open｜把门拉开
tip: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

senses.en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift
Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity
Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty

ex.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。

ex.en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。

tip: 大雨用heavy rain，不用big rain。

senses.en: weighing very little and easy to lift or carry

ex.en: This empty paper box is very light, so I can carry it easily.
ex.zh: 这个空纸箱非常轻，所以我能轻松地拿起来。

ex.en: In science class, we learned why a light plastic ball floats while a heavy stone sinks.
ex.zh: 科学课上，我们学了为什么轻的塑料球会浮起来而重的石头会下沉。

col: light as a feather｜轻如羽毛
tip: 本课作形容词表示“轻的”，它的反义词是 heavy（重的）。

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

col: easy access to｜便于获取或到达……
tip: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

senses.en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand.
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
ex.zh: 这个沉重的行李箱很难搬上楼。

ex.en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。

col: a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

senses.en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize.
To gain something through effort or personal qualities.
A successful result in a competition or contest.

ex.en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。

ex.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

col: win someone's trust｜赢得某人的信任
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

senses.en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape
to make someone do something against their wishes
physical strength used to control or overpower someone

ex.en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
ex.zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。

ex.en: Rising housing costs may force essential workers to move further away from the communities they serve.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能迫使必要岗位的工作人员搬离他们服务的社区。

col: force someone to do something｜迫使某人做某事
tip: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

senses.en: an act of changing position or moving the body
an organised effort by people seeking shared social change
one main section of a long piece of music

ex.en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
ex.zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。

ex.en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。

tip: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something.
In relation to someone or something, especially in attitude.
Helping to achieve a goal or pay for something.

ex.en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
ex.zh: 小狗摇着尾巴朝我跑来。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is an important step towards reducing air pollution in cities.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通是减少城市空气污染的重要一步。

col: work towards a goal｜努力实现目标
go towards the cost｜用于支付部分费用
tip: towards与toward意思相同；前者英式更常用。

senses.en: something that makes an event or situation happen
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
ex.zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

senses.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates
To move or travel very fast
To drive faster than the legal limit

ex.en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
ex.zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。

ex.en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
ex.zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。

tip: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

senses.en: A land reptile with a hard shell and short legs.

ex.en: The tortoise slowly stretched its neck towards a lettuce leaf.
ex.zh: 陆龟慢慢伸长脖子，探向一片生菜叶。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for tortoise populations threatened by illegal trade and agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对受到非法贸易和农业扩张威胁的陆龟种群至关重要。

tip: 通常指陆龟；英式英语中turtle多指海龟。

senses.en: Used when you are both the subject and object.
Used to emphasize the person being addressed.

ex.en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
ex.zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。

ex.en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
ex.zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。

tip: 对应单数you；对多人说“你们自己”用yourselves。

senses.en: something new that someone has designed or created
the act of creating something that did not exist before
a story or explanation created rather than based on facts

ex.en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
ex.zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。

ex.en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。

tip: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

senses.en: a smooth sloped playground structure that children slide down

ex.en: The little boy climbs up and goes down the yellow slide happily.
ex.zh: 这个小男孩爬上去，开心地从黄色滑梯上滑下来。

ex.en: After class, many young students wait in line to play on the tall slide in the park.
ex.zh: 下课后，许多低年级学生排队在公园的高滑梯上玩耍。

col: go down the slide｜滑下滑梯
tip: 本课作名词指游乐场的“滑梯”，常搭配介词on使用，如on the slide。

senses.en: a long board balanced in the middle that goes up and down when two children ride it

ex.en: Sam and Ben play on the seesaw together after school every day.
ex.zh: 萨姆和本每天放学后一起玩跷跷板。

ex.en: In science class, we learn how a seesaw works like a simple lever moving up and down.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们学习跷跷板是如何像一个上下移动的简单杠杆一样工作的。

col: play on the seesaw｜玩跷跷板
a red seesaw｜一个红色的跷跷板
tip: 由see和saw合成，指一上一下的“跷跷板”，常搭配介词on。

senses.en: a small clock worn on your wrist to tell the time

ex.en: My father gives me a nice blue watch for my birthday.
ex.zh: 爸爸在我生日时送给我一块漂亮的蓝色手表。

ex.en: I check my watch every morning so I will never be late for my school bus.
ex.zh: 我每天早上都看手表，这样就永远不会错过校车了。

tip: 本课作名词指“手表”，复数要加es变成watches，注意别混淆。

senses.en: A bar used to move something or control a machine
To move something using a bar as a lever
A means of influencing people or changing a situation

ex.en: Pull this lever to raise the seat a little.
ex.zh: 拉这个操纵杆，把座位稍微升高一点。

ex.en: Tax policy can serve as a powerful lever for encouraging businesses to invest in cleaner technologies.
ex.zh: 税收政策可以成为鼓励企业投资更清洁技术的有力手段。

col: a lever for change｜推动变革的手段
tip: 英式首音节读/liː/，美式通常读/lev/。

senses.en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle.
The circular control used to steer a vehicle.
To move something along on its wheels.

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
ex.zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。

ex.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
ex.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

tip: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.en: A device with moving parts that performs a particular job.
To shape or finish material using a machine.

ex.en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
ex.zh: 洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。

ex.en: A modern machine can perform repetitive tasks efficiently, allowing workers to focus on more complex problems.
ex.zh: 现代机器能高效完成重复性任务，让工人专注于更复杂的问题。

tip: machine是可数名词；machinery是不可数集合名词。

senses.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: happening or used regularly every single day; ordinary and common

ex.en: Brushing our teeth and washing hands are simple everyday habits for health.
ex.zh: 刷牙和洗手是为了健康的简单日常习惯。

ex.en: Our science teacher uses everyday things like plastic bottles and spoons to do fun experiments.
ex.zh: 我们的科学老师用塑料瓶、勺子等每天可见的日常物品做有趣实验。

tip: 合写 everyday 是形容词放在名词前；分开写 every day 作时间状语。

senses.en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.

ex.en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。

ex.en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
ex.zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。

tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

senses.en: the sharp thin end of something, or a tiny dot or exact spot

ex.en: Be careful with the sharp point of your pencil when you write.
ex.zh: 写字的时候要小心铅笔尖锐的笔尖。

ex.en: In maths class, our teacher drew a small point on the board to start a line.
ex.zh: 数学课上，老师在黑板上画了一个小点作为一条线的起点。

tip: 本课作名词表示物体的“尖端”或几何中的“点”，复数为 points。

senses.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
To transport goods by truck.

ex.en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。

ex.en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
ex.zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。

tip: truck常用于美式英语，英式英语常用lorry。

senses.en: in or into the inner part of something
in or into an enclosed place or container
the inner part or surface of something

ex.en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。

ex.en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
ex.zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。

tip: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

senses.en: a sloping surface that joins a lower level to a higher level

ex.en: A smooth ramp helps wheelchairs and strollers enter the library easily.
ex.zh: 一条平缓的坡道能帮助轮椅和婴儿车轻松进入图书馆。

ex.en: In science class, we rolled toy cars down a wooden ramp to test their speed.
ex.zh: 科学课上，我们让玩具小车沿着木制斜坡滚下来测试它们的速度。

col: roll down a ramp｜滚下斜坡
tip: 在科学实验和无障碍设施中常见，表示连接高低两处的“斜坡；坡道”。

senses.en: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.

ex.en: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
ex.zh: 她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。

tip: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

senses.en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.

ex.en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
ex.zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。

ex.en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
ex.zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。

tip: hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

senses.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
The basic qualities that make something what it is.
The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.

ex.en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
ex.zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。

ex.en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
ex.zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。

tip: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex.en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
ex.zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。

ex.en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
ex.zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。

tip: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

senses.en: to press something firmly downward with your hand or foot

ex.en: Push down gently on the soap bottle to get some hand soap.
ex.zh: 轻轻向下按压洗手液瓶子，挤出一些洗手液。

ex.en: During the science test, students push down on the spring to measure how much it moves.
ex.zh: 在科学测试中，同学们向下按压弹簧，测量它移动的距离。

col: push down the button｜按下按钮
tip: push 表示“推；按”，与副词 down 连用精准表达“向下按压”的动作。

senses.en: a large building or area with many different shops and restaurants inside

ex.en: My mum bought me new running shoes at the shopping centre.
ex.zh: 我妈妈在购物中心给我买了新的跑步鞋。

ex.en: On rainy weekends, many Shenzhen families visit a big shopping centre for food and books.
ex.zh: 在下雨的周末，许多深圳家庭会去大型购物中心吃饭和看书。

col: big shopping centre｜大型购物中心
at the shopping centre｜在购物中心
nearby shopping centre｜附近的购物中心
tip: centre 是英式拼写，美式拼写为 center，表示“中心”。

senses.en: a building or room where paintings, drawings, and sculptures are shown to visitors

ex.en: We saw colourful oil paintings at the city art gallery last Sunday.
ex.zh: 上周日我们在城市美术馆看到了色彩丰富的油画。

ex.en: Next Thursday, our art teacher will take our class to a local art gallery for inspiration.
ex.zh: 下周四，美术老师将带我们班去当地的美术馆寻找创作灵感。

col: visit an art gallery｜参观美术馆
in the art gallery｜在美术馆里
tip: art 以元音音素开头，表达“一家美术馆”时前面要用不定冠词 an。

senses.en: a large outdoor park with exciting rides, games, and shows for fun

ex.en: Children love riding the big Ferris wheel at the amusement park.
ex.zh: 孩子们喜欢在游乐园里坐大摩天轮。

ex.en: During the holiday, our family spent a sunny afternoon exploring rides at a famous amusement park.
ex.zh: 假期里，我们一家人在一个著名的游乐园度过了一个阳光明媚的下午。

col: go to an amusement park｜去游乐园
amusement park rides｜游乐园游乐设施
tip: amusement 以元音音素 /ə/ 开头，“一个游乐园”要用 an amusement park。

senses.en: an old building that is important because of its past and culture

ex.en: People work hard to protect every old historic building in our city.
ex.zh: 人们努力保护我们城市里每一座古老的历史建筑。

ex.en: In history club, we took photos of a famous historic building with curved wooden roofs.
ex.zh: 在历史社团里，我们拍摄了一座有着弧形木屋顶的著名历史建筑。

col: protect a historic building｜保护历史建筑
visit a historic building｜参观历史建筑
ancient historic building｜古老的历史建筑
tip: historic 是形容词“有历史意义的”，修饰名词 building。

senses.en: a newly designed building made with steel, glass, and new technology

ex.en: That tall glass tower is a bright modern building in Shenzhen.
ex.zh: 那座高大的玻璃塔楼是深圳一栋明亮的现代建筑。

ex.en: Our new school library is a modern building that uses solar panels on its roof.
ex.zh: 我们学校的新图书馆是一座现代建筑，屋顶上装有太阳能电池板。

col: tall modern building｜高大的现代建筑
design a modern building｜设计现代建筑
inside a modern building｜在现代建筑里
tip: modern 意为“现代的”，常与 historic（历史的）形成对比记忆。

senses.en: a quick photo or a short, clear introduction showing the main facts

ex.en: I took a quick snapshot of the cute panda eating bamboo.
ex.zh: 我给正在吃竹子的可爱大熊猫快速拍了一张快照。

ex.en: Our travel guide gives a useful snapshot of Shenzhen's weather, parks, and local snacks.
ex.zh: 我们的旅游指南对深圳的天气、公园和当地小吃做了实用的简介。

tip: 由 snap（抓拍）和 shot（镜头）合成，既指“快照”也可指“简短介绍”。

senses.en: not a single person
a person considered unimportant or unknown

ex.en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。

ex.en: Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 任何人都不应因家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；本身含否定意义。

senses.en: feeling tired and unhappy because nothing interesting is happening

ex.en: Jack felt bored when it rained all day and he stayed inside.
ex.zh: 整天下雨只能待在室内时，杰克觉得很厌倦。

ex.en: Students never feel bored during science lessons because they do fun experiments by themselves.
ex.zh: 同学们在科学课上从不觉得厌倦，因为他们能亲手做有趣的实验。

col: get bored easily｜容易感到无聊
never look bored｜从不显得厌倦
tip: bored 用来形容人的感受“感到厌倦的”；形容事物无聊要用 boring。

senses.en: A male ruler of an empire.

ex.en: The museum displays a robe once worn by an emperor.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一件皇帝曾穿过的袍子。

ex.en: The emperor expanded trade routes, allowing goods and cultural practices to spread across the empire.
ex.zh: 这位皇帝拓展了贸易路线，使商品和文化习俗得以在帝国各地传播。

col: crown someone emperor｜为某人加冕称帝
tip: emperor统治empire；empress指女皇或皇后。

senses.en: at a time in the past that is no longer true now

ex.en: This quiet park was once a small fishing village many years ago.
ex.zh: 很多年前，这座安静的公园曾经是一个小渔村。

ex.en: Our teacher told us that huge dinosaurs once walked across green forests on the earth.
ex.zh: 老师告诉我们，巨大的恐龙曾经在地球上的绿色森林里行走。

col: once lived here｜曾经住在这里
tip: 本课作副词意为“曾经”，通常放在动词之前或 be 动词之后。

senses.en: a musical drama in which performers sing most words

ex.en: We watched an opera at the theatre last night.
ex.zh: 我们昨晚在剧院看了一部歌剧。

ex.en: Public funding for opera can preserve artistic traditions while making performances accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 为歌剧提供公共资助既能保护艺术传统，也能让更多观众有机会欣赏演出。

tip: 泛指歌剧艺术时不可数；一部歌剧用an opera。

senses.en: to give something to someone in exchange for money
to be bought in a particular quantity or way
to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
ex.zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

col: sell something to someone｜把某物卖给某人
sell an idea｜推销一个想法
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

senses.en: a combination of two or more different things put together

ex.en: This tasty fruit salad is a mix of apples, bananas, and grapes.
ex.zh: 这份美味的水果沙拉是苹果、香蕉和葡萄的混合。

ex.en: Shenzhen is an exciting city with a mix of modern towers and quiet green hills.
ex.zh: 深圳是一座令人振奋的城市，融合了现代高楼和宁静青山。

col: a mix of colours｜多种颜色的混合
a mix of old and new｜新旧交融
a mix of fruits｜多种水果的混合
tip: mix 在这里作名词表示“混合（物）”，of 后面常接复数名词或不可数名词。

senses.en: a very large number of things or people, too many to count

ex.en: Thousands of bright stars shine in the dark sky on clear nights.
ex.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，成千上万颗明亮的星星在夜空中闪烁。

ex.en: Every autumn, thousands of birds fly south to warm wetlands near Shenzhen Bay for winter.
ex.zh: 每年秋天，成千上万只鸟儿都会向南飞到深圳湾附近的温暖湿地过冬。

col: thousands of birds｜成千上万只鸟
thousands of books｜成千上万本书
thousands of visitors｜成千上万名游客
tip: 表示模糊数量“成千上万的”时，thousand 要加 s 且后面必须接 of。

senses.en: to travel to another place for a short holiday or visit

ex.en: My family wants to take a trip to the beach next month.
ex.zh: 我们一家人下个月想去海滩旅行。

ex.en: During the winter holiday, many students take a trip with their parents to see snow.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，许多同学会和父母一起去旅行看雪。

col: take a short trip｜去短途旅行
plan to take a trip｜计划去旅行
tip: 表示“去某地旅行”常用 take a trip to + 地点，注意 trip 前加 a。

senses.en: a tiny round amount of liquid such as water, rain, or oil

ex.en: A drop of rain fell on my nose as I walked home.
ex.zh: 我走回家的时候，一滴雨落在了我的鼻子上。

ex.en: In science class, we put a drop of red ink into water to watch colours spread.
ex.zh: 科学课上，我们往水里滴入一滴红墨水，观察颜色是如何扩散的。

col: a drop of ink｜一滴墨水
tip: 用来计量不可数液体，表示“两滴”时把 drop 变复数，如 two drops of。

senses.zh: 不平常；与众不同；不同的；有区别的

senses.en: not the same as someone or something else
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

senses.en: to become aware of something through your senses
a written statement giving information or instructions
information given before something happens or ends

ex.en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
ex.zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？

ex.en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
ex.zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。

col: at short notice｜在通知很仓促的情况下
tip: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck, usually white

ex.en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
ex.zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。

ex.en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
ex.zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。

col: a pair of swans｜一对天鹅
tip: 可数名词，复数swans；幼天鹅称cygnet。

senses.en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with.
Someone you share a romantic relationship or married life with.
Work or take part in an activity with someone.

ex.en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
ex.zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。

ex.en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
ex.zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。

tip: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。

senses.en: having a thin, often attractive shape
very small in amount or likelihood
to lose weight or reduce something in size

ex.en: This slim lamp fits neatly on my small desk.
ex.zh: 这盏细长的灯放在我的小书桌上正合适。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, there is only a slim chance that commuters will stop driving.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，通勤者放弃开车的可能性就很小。

tip: 形容身材多含褒义；slim chance指机会渺茫。

senses.en: having a round, heavy body with extra weight

ex.en: Look at that cute fat cat sleeping warmly in the afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 看那只可爱的胖猫咪，正在午后的阳光下暖暖地睡觉。

ex.en: In the picture book, a fat brown bear eats sweet berries before its winter sleep.
ex.zh: 在绘本故事里，一只胖胖的棕熊在冬眠前吃着甜美的浆果。

tip: 形容动物或人物可爱胖胖的常用 fat；形容人时更礼貌的说法可用 heavy。

senses.en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
ex.zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。

ex.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
ex.zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。

tip: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。
